'''Cesar's Informant''' is a minor character in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

==History==
===Background===
He is a friend of an "associate of an associate" of [[Cesar Vialpando]] who handles freight containers at the docks in [[Easter Basin]].

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''===
The unnamed character gives Cesar a tip-off of that one of the containers is carrying a [[Jester]] sports car, which is currently on [[Carl Johnson]]'s wishlist for the [[Wang Cars (GTA San Andreas)|Wang Cars]] showroom.

==Character==
===Appearance===
The character uses a cut [[Grove Street Families]] character model "<code>csblue2</code>".

==Mission Appearances==
*[[Customs Fast Track]]
